question: What is the meaning of human toxicological effects non-carcinogenic in relation to environmental performance?
description: Human toxicological effects non-carcinogenic refer to the adverse health impacts on humans that are not related to cancer. In the context of environmental performance, these impacts are considered in Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) to evaluate the potential risks associated with the use of materials or products. However, due to the lack of broad consensus and harmonisation in the LCA community, there is no clear guidance on how to accurately quantify these impacts in practice. As a result, many LCA practitioners may choose to exclude these effects from their calculations. This highlights the ongoing challenges in integrating human health impacts into environmental assessments.
